changes_made.explanation: Consolidated duplicate task names into 'Other:Value-Informed Action Generation'. Normalized model names to standard capitalization (Gemma-2-9B, DeepSeek-R1). Removed redundant output descriptions.

Removed human evaluation metrics (Correctness, Harmlessness, Sufficiency, Plausibility) as they are not automatic metrics. Consolidated duplicate F1 metrics. Kept core alignment metrics: F1 Score, Manhattan Distance, Alignment Ranking.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper. The LLMs were used as generators, not evaluators.

guideline: Annotators evaluated generated actions and explanations using four quality metrics: Correctness, Harmlessness, Sufficiency, and Plausibility

overall_notes: The paper focuses on evaluating value-action alignment in LLMs through contextual action generation tasks. It uses both automatic metrics (F1, Manhattan Distance, Ranking) and human evaluation. The extraction was generally accurate but needed some normalization and removal of human eval metrics from the automatic metrics list.
